basic_info.description: Mid-century modern meets contemporary elegance in this meticulously and entirely renovated Eichler home offering indoor-outdoor living at its best. Nestled on a wide, quiet, tree-lined street in Diamond Heights, this 5 bed, 2.5 bath architectural gem captures the essence of California modern with an open floor plan, clean lines, and intimate connection to the landscape. Access to the outdoors on all three levels via balconies, an inner courtyard and two gardens offer private areas to unwind or entertain. The chef’s kitchen features sleek cabinetry, Thermador appliances, and an oversized central island. Adjacent are the dining and living rooms, bathed in natural light, and opening to a balcony on one side and tranquil central courtyard on the other. Rounding out this floor is a half bath and main level bedroom, perfect for guests or home office. Upstairs are four bedrooms including a primary suite boasting a luxurious bathroom with dual vanities and soaking tub. Two-car garage with interior access that opens to a sizeable and flexible foyer.  New systems throughout including electrical, heating and plumbing; new roof and flooring; seismic upgrades; dual pane windows; and more. Located near Glen Park Canyon Park and hiking trails, transportation and everyday conveniences.
